# Solar PV Fleet (PVFleetAdapter)

> **Class**: `energysim.container.PVFleetAdapter` | add to a world with `add_fleet(fleet_type='pv', ...)` (accepted kinds: `pv`, `pv_fleet`)

## Overview

Vectorized Solar Photovoltaic (PV) fleet adapter.

Simulates N solar rooftop systems with heterogeneous peak capacities:
  T_cell = T_amb + (G / 800) * 25
  P = P_peak * (G / 1000) * [1 + gamma * (T_cell - 25)] * PR     (clipped at >= 0)

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `str` | `'pv_fleet'` | - | Container (simulator) name. |
| `size` | `int` | `100` | - | Number of entities N in the fleet. |
| `peak_kw` | `Union[float, np.ndarray]` | `5.0` | kWp | Peak DC capacity per system (scalar or length-N array). |
| `gamma_temp_coeff` | `float` | `-0.004` | 1/K | Power temperature coefficient (negative). |
| `performance_ratio` | `float` | `0.85` | 1 | System derate (inverter, wiring, soiling). |
| `step_size` | `float` | `900.0` | s | Micro time-step. |

## Inputs

| Variable | Unit | Aliases |
|---|---|---|
| `irradiance_w_m2` | m2 | `g_irr`, `g_irr_w_m2`, `irradiance` |
| `t_ambient` | unspecified | `t_amb`, `t_amb_degc` |

## Outputs

| Variable | Unit | Aliases |
|---|---|---|
| `p_kw` | kW | `p_pv`, `p_pv_kw` |

Every output `<var>` is also available as `total_<var>`, `mean_<var>`, `min_<var>`, `max_<var>` and per entity as `<var>[i]`. Units that read `unspecified` are not declared by the container; connections to or from them are never rescaled (see [Units](../units.md)).

## Validation

The fleet is tested against an explicit loop of scalar models (`tests/strengths/test_vectorized_fleets.py`); see [Validation](../validation.md).

## Usage example

```python
from energysim import world

sim = world(start_time=0, stop_time=3600, t_macro=900, power_unit='kW')
sim.add_fleet(fleet_type='pv', name='rooftops', size=1000, peak_kw=5.0, step_size=900, power_unit='kW')
sim.add_signal('irradiance', lambda t: [800.0], step_size=900)
sim.add_signal('temperature', lambda t: [25.0], step_size=900, units={'y': 'degC'})
sim.add_connections({'irradiance.y': 'rooftops.irradiance_w_m2', 'temperature.y': 'rooftops.t_ambient'})
res = sim.simulate()
print(res['rooftops.total_p_kw'])
```
